title: Evergreen drift report v1
description: Every runtime version a repository states, with its exact file and line, the release it resolves to offline, and whether the pins agree. Reading a repository only; no network access and no written file.

runtimes.description: One entry per runtime with at least one pin, ordered by runtime id.

pins.description: Every value found, ordered by path, line, and source, including values that do not resolve.

releases.description: Distinct releases among `pin` values, sorted ascending, such as `["1.21", "1.22"]`.

drifted.description: True when no release is selected by every group of alternatives.

floorConflicts.description: Floors above the lowest pinned release, which that pinned environment cannot satisfy.

source.description: The file or field the value comes from, such as `.go-version` or `Dockerfile FROM`.

kind.description: `pin` selects the version that builds or runs; `floor` is a minimum the project supports.

group.description: Pins that share a group are alternatives, such as the entries of one multi-target list; they are reported but not compared with each other.

release.description: The release line the value resolves to offline; absent when it cannot be resolved.

unresolved.description: Why `release` is absent, in one sentence.
